heads.name: PromQL
heads.description: The metrics query head. Parses with the upstream Apache prometheus parser and serves the Prometheus HTTP API.

heads.name: LogQL
heads.description: The logs query head. Parses with cerberus's in-house Apache reimplementation and serves the Loki HTTP API.

heads.name: TraceQL
heads.description: The traces query head. Parses with cerberus's in-house Apache reimplementation and serves the Tempo HTTP API.
